title: BECE English Studies: Grammar & Structure - English Studies - Parts of Speech - Nouns
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the correct collective noun to complete the sentence:
A _____ of lions was seen resting under the acacia tree.
questions.explain: A group of lions is correctly referred to as a 'pride'. 'Flock' is typically used for birds or sheep, 'herd' for cattle or elephants, and 'pack' for dogs or wolves.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Which of the following words from the sentence is an abstract noun?
"His bravery during the crisis earned him great respect."
questions.explain: An abstract noun refers to a concept, quality, or state that cannot be touched or seen. 'Bravery' is a quality, making it an abstract noun. 'Earned' is a verb, 'crisis' is a common noun denoting an event, and 'him' is a pronoun.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate noun form to complete the sentence:
"The school recently purchased new _____ for the science laboratory."
questions.explain: 'Equipment' is an uncountable noun and does not take an 's' to form a plural. We use the singular form even when referring to multiple items of equipment.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence:
"The principal gave the students a lot of important _____."
questions.explain: The word 'information' is an uncountable (or mass) noun in English. It cannot be made plural by adding 's', regardless of the quantity.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Identify the correct plural form of the compound noun in the sentence:
"His three _____ came to visit him during the holidays."
questions.explain: For compound nouns formed with a noun and a prepositional phrase (like brother-in-law), the plural 's' is added to the principal word (brother), making it 'brothers-in-law'.
questions.subject: English Studies
